summary: Dfs::new premarks node 0 as discovered, causing SCC's first traversal to skip it and potentially omit its component. Dfs::empty allows every node to participate in the first pass. Blocked: the only existing SCC test, scc in tests/ograph.rs, does not demonstrate the bug. Static inspection indicates its directed and undirected cases still recover node 0 during the second pass and produce the expected components after reversal. No tests were executed.
